sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
ஆதவனை அணைத்திடவே விரைந்திட்ட ஆஞ்சனேயா
மாதவனை ஒருக்காலும் மறவாத மாருதியே
sections.translit:
Adhavanai aNaitthidavE viraindhitta AnchanEyA
mAdhavanai orukkAlum maRavAdha mAruthiyE
sections.en: Oh Anchaneya, you rushed to hug the hot sun. You are so devoted and would never forget Lord Vishnu.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
நெஞ்சிலே உனை கொண்டேன் தூயா
தஞ்சமருள் கருணையோடு அஞ்சனை சேயா
sections.translit:
nenjilE unai koNdEn thUyA
thanjamaruL karuNaiyOdu anjanai sEya
sections.en: Son of Anjanai and the immaculate one, I have enshrined you in my heart. Please have compassion and offer salvation to me.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
தும்புருவும் நாரதரும் நாணிக் கோண
என்புருக ராம நாமம் ஜபித்து நின்றாய்
பண்ணிடை மெய் மறந்த பரந்தாமன் போல்
மண்ணிடை உன்னினைவாய் வாழ்ந்திடுவேன்
sections.translit:
thumburuvum nAradharum nANik kONa
enburuga Rama nAmam japitthu nindRAy
paNNidai mey maRandha parandhAman pOl
maNNidai unninaivAy vAzhndhiduvEn
sections.en: When sages Thumburu and Narada entered a musical contest, they could not match your chanting of Sri Rama’s name. You melted the hearts of everyone in the audience, and the sages hung their heads in shame and embarrassment. Lord Vishnu, who could not resist your divine music, stood in the audience, totally lost in your devotion and scholarship. Anchaneya, I will follow Lord Vishnu’s example and think only about you every minute of my life on this earth.

notes: Reference is made in this song to the classic mythological story of a veena music competition between sages Thumburu and Narada. Both exhibited virtuosity and the audience was thrilled. Vishnu had asked Hanuman to judge the contest. Hanuman took out the frets from the veenas and asked the sages to play. Both could not, whereupon Anchaneya enthralled the audience playing the fretless veenas with a bamboo sliding stick and singing the glory of Sri Hari. The sages felt ashamed of their egos and Vishnu, who was in the audience immersed in the music, lavishly praised the devotion of Anchaneya. For more details see Hanuman judges Sages Narada & Tumburu’s concert
